description:
Field trial trait data held in CropSNPdb for this crop (T3 trials with Crop Ontology trait IDs, Australian Grains
Genebank records). With no arguments, lists the available traits. Filter by line and/or trait: trait matches the
exact name or any part of it (e.g. 'Height', 'grain yield'). Most phenotyped lines are in the
wheat90k dataset.
name: snp_phenotypes
